entry.title: Lectric eBikes XP Lite3
entry.summary: Lectric takes its popular folding e-bike into its third generation with the XP Lite3, adding thoughtful upgrades while keeping the approachable $799 price point. The 49-pound frame packs a Stealth M24 motor, five pedal-assist modes, speeds up to 20 mph, and up to 80 miles of rang
entry.content:
Lectric takes its popular folding e-bike into its third generation with the XP Lite3, adding thoughtful upgrades while keeping the approachable $799 price point. The 49-pound frame packs a Stealth M24 motor, five pedal-assist modes, speeds up to 20 mph, and up to 80 miles of range. New additions include a reinforced folding latch, quick-release pedals, integrated rear turn signals, a full-color 3.5-inch display, and upgraded hydraulic brakes. A redesigned frame improves riding ergonomics, while an optional Gates Carbon Belt Drive offers a lower-maintenance alternative to the traditional chain. Available in a range of fresh colorways, the XP Lite3 delivers a more refined take on compact, everyday electric transportation.

entry.title: 1995 Land Rover Range Rover County Classic
entry.summary: Congleton Service, the Vermont shop widely regarded as the top authority on Range Rover Classic restoration, completed the bulk of the work on this 1995 County Classic in 2019. The factory 3.9-liter V8 was swapped for a larger 4.2-liter unit pulled from a Range Rover LWB, rebuilt
entry.content:
Congleton Service, the Vermont shop widely regarded as the top authority on Range Rover Classic restoration, completed the bulk of the work on this 1995 County Classic in 2019. The factory 3.9-liter V8 was swapped for a larger 4.2-liter unit pulled from a Range Rover LWB, rebuilt from the ground up with hand-fitted internals rather than dropped in as-is. Congleton also rebuilt the transmission and transfer case, fitted new shocks, a steering rod, and a steering damper to the truck's already-converted coil suspension, and repainted the body in its original Beluga Black over Sorrell Tan leather. It shows 127,000 miles on the odometer, and the current owner has kept up service, including a July 2026 round of work on the differential and front suspension. The 1995 model represents the final year of the original Range Rover Classic, the vehicle that effectively invented the luxury SUV category back in 1970.

entry.title: La Tour Eiffel Diamond Light
entry.summary: Built around an authentic light bulb that once illuminated the Eiffel Tower, the Diamond Light brings a piece of Parisian history into any space. The Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel collaborated with A+A Cooren Design Studio and Lagardère x Arteum (LxA) to create a colle
entry.content:
Built around an authentic light bulb that once illuminated the Eiffel Tower, the Diamond Light brings a piece of Parisian history into any space. The Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel collaborated with A+A Cooren Design Studio and Lagardère x Arteum (LxA) to create a collector's lamp drawing from Gustave Eiffel's original tower blueprints while preserving traces of weathered patina from the bulb's life 1,000 feet above Paris. Designed in France and set on an iron-alloy base with a wooden case, the lamp features three lighting modes recreating the monument's illumination, including its signature sparkle cycle for 5 minutes at the top of each hour. Published by Lagardère x Arteum (LxA) and the Eiffel Tower, each lamp is individually numbered and includes an official certificate of authenticity. Only 500 pieces will be produced worldwide. An official Eiffel Tower product.
